practice_phrases.known: We don't need to go there.

practice_phrases.known: I don't need to know that now.
practice_phrases.target: 我现在不需要知道那个。

practice_phrases.known: You don't need to try so hard.

practice_phrases.target: 我们不需要听更多关于这门语言的词。
